mechanism: Chloroquine may enhance the cardiac depressant effects of beta-blockers like timolol, and both agents can affect cardiac conduction and potentially cause bradycardia or AV block.
action: Monitor heart rate and cardiac function; consider alternative antimalarial if patient requires systemic chloroquine; ophthalmic timolol has minimal systemic absorption but caution is warranted in patients with pre-existing cardiac conduction abnormalities.
